frontMatter.about:
At AML RightSource, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Your talents, perspectives, and commitment to excellence drive our mission forward and shape the impact we make every day.
Our vision is clear: to be the leading Expert Solutions provider that our clients and partners count on each day to prevent financial crimes and increase transparency with third parties—so that they can confidently and safely deliver great outcomes for their customers and communities. This purpose guides our actions, unites our teams, and underscores the value of the work we do.
This handbook is here to support you. It outlines the policies, values, and resources that define how we work, collaborate, and grow together. Whether you’re navigating day-to-day responsibilities, looking for guidance, or exploring new opportunities within the organization, these pages are designed to help you succeed.
Thank you for being part of AML RightSource. Together, we are reimagining compliance.
The AML RightSource Leadership Team #ReimaginingCompliance | #OneTeam
frontMatter.purpose:
AML RightSource is the leading technology enabled managed services Company, focused on fighting financial crime and reimagining compliance for our clients around the world. Headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio and operating across the globe, we provide custom solutions to financial institutions, FinTechs, money service businesses, and corporations.
Using a blend of highly trained anti-financial crime professionals, cutting edge technology, and industry leading consultants, AML RightSource assists clients with their Anti-Money Laundering (AML)/Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), transaction monitoring, client onboarding (Know Your Customer - KYC), enhanced due diligence (EDD), and risk management needs. We support clients in meeting day-to-day compliance tasks, urgent projects, and strategic changes. Globally, our staff of highly trained analysts and subject matter experts is the industry's largest group of full-time compliance professionals.
AML RightSource believes in fostering a workplace that is ethical, productive, inclusive, and respectful. In addition, AML RightSource has contractual commitments to its clients related to Confidentiality, Privacy, and Security. The company has implemented this Global Employee Handbook and related Policies to give guidance about the expected workplace environment and Code of Conduct. Employees are also required to review and abide by any additional policies that are applicable to your office location.
This Global Employee Handbook covers all employees across all global locations of the AML RightSource Group of Companies. It applies across the Group’s applicable offices, facilities, legal entities, registered business addresses, partner-office arrangements, and other relevant locations. chapters.title: Training and Awareness
chapters.text:
- AMLRS ensures all employees, including management, receive mandatory training on company policies, grievance procedures, workplace conduct, and reporting. Tailored workshops are also held to address recurring issues and promote a respectful environment. Additionally, HR personnel and investigators undergo specialized training to handle grievances professionally and in line with legal and internal standards.
## Non-Retaliation
- AMLRS upholds a zero-tolerance policy against retaliation, ensuring no one faces negative consequences for reporting a grievance in good faith. Any retaliatory actions are promptly investigated and addressed with appropriate disciplinary measures.
## Monitoring
- HR continuously monitors the grievance process to ensure timely, effective handling of complaints. Regular reviews are conducted to maintain transparency, efficiency, and accountability, and to identify opportunities for improvement.
## Conformity
- The grievance process strictly adheres to local, national, and international laws, ensuring high legal and ethical standards. It is regularly reviewed and updated to stay aligned with changing regulations and best practices.
## Review and Improvement
AMLRS conducts annual reviews of its grievance procedures, incorporating employee feedback, past case outcomes, and best practices. This supports continuous improvement by addressing gaps and ensuring the process stays effective, fair, and responsive.
Learning, development, and engagement are essential parts of the employee experience at AML RightSource. The Global Learning & Development department serves our organization in a variety of ways, through culture integration, employee engagement, leadership development programming, and technical training.
## Talent Development
Our people are at the core of how AML RightSource achieves its goals. Our leadership development programs, interactive e-learning, and targeted skills training provide employees with the tools they need to do just that
Emerge is a 3-month leadership development program designed for high-potential employees who are currently in SAI, SAII, or other non-manager roles responsible for supporting others. Emerge is open to all departments. Participants must have spent a minimum of 6 months in their current role before joining the Emerge program.
Ignite: Managed Services is a 4-week development course required for all newly promoted or onboarded Managed Services managers. Participants will receive a blend of technical learning and the leadership development skills necessary for their management role at AML RightSource.
Ignite: Non-Managed Services is a 6-week development course required for all newly promoted or onboarded Non-Managed Services managers. Participants will receive the leadership development skills necessary for their management role at AML RightSource.
Rise brings cohorts of leaderstogether from all areas of the organization, into a cross-collaborative learning environment. Divided into three, six-month tracks, leaders will learn how to navigate industry changes, lead teams with purpose and influence, and gain a greater understanding of the importance of their role at AML RightSource. To be eligible to participate, you must be a current AML RightSource manager or above and nominated by a director.
Equip provides integral tools and techniques to excel in a Quality Control (QC) role at AML RightSource. Sessions blend technical content with interpersonal skills exercises based on real-world QC scenarios. The program also features individualized feedback from L&D trainers and personalized coaching sessions over the course of the four-session program.
For further information on the above training programs, please see our Learning & Development page on OneNet - (https://amlrightsource.sharepoint.com/sites/OneNet/people-culture/GlobalL&D/)Leadership Development Guide.
## AML RightSource Technical Training
The core business of AML RightSource is to provide highly trained AML professionals to its clients. AML RightSource believes in supporting its employees by providing in-house technical training through our new hire and continuing education programs.
## Embark: New Hire Training Program
The mission of the Embark new hire training program is to provide the necessary skills and knowledge to employees as they begin their AML careers. The selection of the new hire training curriculum is based on operational feedback, scope and demands of client assignments, and emerging AML industry trends. The program consists of classroom instruction and practical, hands-on training. During the entire program, employees receive instruction and continuous feedback, including tests and assessments, from members of the Technical Training Team. Employes must meet the requirements of the Embark program to be eligible for client work.
## Evolve: Continuing Education Program
Employees are eligible to participate in the continuing education program.

chapters.title: Code Of Conduct
chapters.text:
AML RightSource has the following Code of Conduct Policies to outline Company expectations for all employees and management.
## WHISTLEBLOWER/ANTI-RETALIATION
Reports of violations or suspected violations will be kept confidential to the greatest extent possible, consistent with the need to conduct an adequate investigation.
This policy expressly prohibits retaliation, including harassment, reprisal, intimidation, adverse employment actions, or any other form of retaliation, against employees who in good faith raise suspected violations of Company policy and/or law, cooperate in inquiries or investigations, or identify potential violations of Company policies or incidents of inappropriate conduct of any kind. Reports of retaliation will be investigated promptly and, in a manner intended to protect confidentiality, consistent with a full and fair investigation. Human Resources will lead and conduct the investigation. If necessary, other internal or external parties may be engaged to assist or conduct the investigation.
- Any employee who engages in retaliation will be subject to discipline, up to and including termination.
- Any employee who believes that he or she has been subjected to any form of retaliation as a result of reporting a suspected violation of law or policy should immediately report the retaliation to Human Resources.
Anyone filing a complaint concerning a violation or suspected violation of the Ethics policy, any other Company policy or law must be acting in good faith and have reasonable grounds for believing the information disclosed indicates a violation. Any allegations that prove to be unsubstantiated and which prove to have been made maliciously or knowingly to be false will be viewed as a serious disciplinary offense subject to disciplinary action.
For any employees in countries that have separate legislation covering this topic, please refer to your local policy on #OneNet.
## TWO-WAY COMMUNICATION
## The Company aims to establish open, structured communication between employees and management at AMLRS to promote transparency, engagement, and continuous improvement. It applies to all staff and leaders, with various leadership teams coordinating interactive sessions such as quarterly company-wide town halls, monthly and/or ad hoc departmental meetings, dialogue forums on the cadence communicated by the company, and one-on-one feedback opportunities. Employees are encouraged to share concerns openly or anonymously, while management is expected to respond promptly and provide updates. Sessions may be documented, with follow-up actions and regular updates ensuring accountability. Participation is promoted through early communication, recognition, and regular evaluations to refine the process and maintain its effectiveness.
## EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER AND DISCRIMINATION
AML RightSource provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. We will not discriminate in our business, employment, or hiring practices based on any legally recognized protected ground in each country in which we operate, including, but not limited to: race, color, citizenship, religion, political affiliation, gender, gender identity/ gender expression, age, marital status, civil partnership, family status, veteran status, record of offences, national/ethnic origin, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law or identified as best practices in the jurisdictions in which we operate. Depending on your country of employment, the terminology of the various protected grounds may differ from the terminology in the handbook.
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment (full time, part time, hourly, or contractual), including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training, and is to be implemented without discrimination or harassment of any kind. AML RightSource will provide reasonable accommodation for individuals where a disability, religious requirement, or any other protected ground requires the company to address the needs of the individual based on protected grounds of discrimination within the various countries which we operate, unless undue hardship on the operation of the business would result. Employees who may require reasonable accommodation should contact Human Resources.
## WORKPLACE ENVIRONMENT – HEALTH, SAFETY & SECURITY
AML RightSource is committed to maintaining a safe and respectful workplace environment where a high value is placed on integrity, fairness and respect; our shared success depends on it. All employees are expected to comply with the relevant workplace Health and Safety Policies of the country in which they are employed.

chapters.title: Confidentiality
chapters.text:
Employees may have access to confidential, proprietary or private information of various types, including financial records, Client and Company business information, personally identifiable information, intellectual property and other information subject to contractual or legal obligations of confidentiality. All employees must follow all applicable legal, contractual and policy restrictions on the use. Specifically, employees must adhere to the following guidelines:
- Employees shall not disclose client information to anyone who does not work for the Company, including other customers or third parties and members of one’s own family. Additionally, client information is not allowed to be disclosed between different internal teams.
- Examples of confidential information include, but are not limited to, the name of the client, financial data, sales records and client records.
- All client information is assumed to be confidential unless otherwise noted and therefore falls under this policy.
- Employees are prohibited from transferring any information from a client or AML RightSource email account to their personal email account.
- Employees are prohibited from sending email communications from client email accounts to AML RightSource company email accounts without prior management authorization.
- Responsibility to protect our Company’s information falls on every employee. All employees share a common interest in making certain that information is not improperly or accidentally disclosed. Any employee aware of a breach in client confidentiality must inform their management.
- Failure to adhere to the specific guidelines in this policy may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment. Disciplinary action may, and will likely, forego warnings given the severity violating client trust.
These guidelines are meant to supplement any individual Agreement signed by an employee:
## Prior to Employment
AML RightSource has a Confidentiality Agreement that is signed during the onboarding stage. as a condition of employment, outlining the responsibilities employees have in the protection of Company information.
## During Employment
AML RightSource may update the Confidentiality Agreement from time to time. As such, AML RightSource may require employees to sign an updated agreement. Refusal to do so may result in termination of employment.
## Post-Employment
The contractual commitment in the Confidentiality Agreement extends beyond the employee’s term of employment. Employees are prohibited from retaining company and client confidential documentation or sharing with others any knowledge obtained about such confidential information.
While AML RightSource recognizes that we may not prohibit our employees from posting personal opinions and content on private accounts, we do expect our employees to uphold the highest level of respect and adhere to our company’s anti-discriminatory and harassment policies.
Further, it is critical that employees recognize that they are representing the Company when accessing these sites and they communicate within the guidelines below:
- Employees are not to purport to represent the Company when making statements or opinions on social media.
- Employees should never identify a customer or coworker in an online posting without his or her permission.
- Employees should get appropriate permission before referring to or posting images of current or former employees, members, vendors or suppliers. Additionally, employees should get appropriate permission to use a third party’s copyrights, copyrighted material, trademarks, service marks or other intellectual property. All employees are ambassadors of AML RightSource and have a responsibility to maintain AML RightSource’s public image; therefore, it is expected that employees will not disparage the Company when communicating to others.
- The Company may be liable for online activity that uses company assets, a company email address or any email address that can be traced back to the Company’s domain, which generally is any internet address affiliated with the Company. Use of and login to social media from Company assets must be approved by Management and coordinated with IT.
- Employees are not to publish, post or release any information via social media sites (i.e., Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, blogging sites, etc.) or other means that is considered confidential or not public.
- Company clients, including client names, must remain confidential at all times.
Nothing in this policy is meant to, nor will be applied to, limit employees’ rights to discuss terms of employment if protected under local laws.

chapters.title: Conflict of Interest
chapters.text:
All employees have an obligation to examine any situation in which they may have a conflict of interest and take steps to resolve the conflict. Any employee who is concerned about a potential conflict or how to resolve a conflict, should consult with their manager and/or Human Resources.
While employed by AML RightSource, you agree that you shall not, directly or indirectly, be employed or engaged in any employment or other business activity that would interfere with the performance of your duties at AML RightSource or that would constitute an actual or perceived conflict of interest. Use of the Company’s time or resources for other business activities or engaging in any activity that would constitute a conflict of interest or would be likely to bring disrepute or embarrassment to the Company’s reputation is strictly prohibited.
## Anti-Competition
AML RightSource abides by laws regarding anti-competitive practices. Any employee must not share market data, pricing, or client lists with competitors for the purpose of setting prices for services in the marketplace.
## Human Trafficking and Exploitation
Human Trafficking and Exploitation/ Modern-day slavery comes in many different guises. It includes the exercise of ownership over a person, services coerced under threat, human trafficking and child labor exploitation. All instances of modern slavery have in common the violation of the human rights of an individual for the benefit of another.
AML RightSource condemns modern slavery in all its manifestations and has a zero-tolerance approach to it. The Company believes in the ethical treatment of the individual and in respect for human rights and dignity and encourages and promotes a corresponding attitude in its directors, employees and contractors.
AML RightSource does not employ in any capacity the services of any person under the minimum legal working age applicable to such position; the Company does not engage any vendor using slave labor. The Company will terminate its relationship with any contractor who is in breach. Further legal steps may be taken which may include criminal prosecution.
Employees who suspect an incidence of modern slavery associated with the Company or with any of its contractors should raise their concerns with the Human Resources, or utilize the Ethics Portal, if they wish to remain anonymous.
Reference: Modern Slavery Act 2015
Reference: Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act - 1956, POCSO Act - 2012, Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act - 1976
## Anti-Corruption/Anti-Bribery
AML RightSource employees, whether operating directly or through third parties through which its clients conduct its business, must comply with all applicable anti-bribery, anti-corruption laws and policies of all jurisdictions in which we do business. This includes but is not limited to the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (“FCPA”), the U.K. Bribery Act 2010 (“U.K. Bribery Act”), Section 177 of the Companies Act 2013, and The Prevention of Corruption Act 1988 which defines the course of action under the Indian jurisdictions.
- Prohibited Business Practices. AML RightSource employees are prohibited from engaging, whether directly or through an Agent or other third party, in bribery or corruption in order to secure an undue advantage in the Company’s business. This prohibition applies to any transactions involving either Commercial Parties or Government Officials. Company employees are also prohibited from directly or indirectly falsifying any book or record of the Company, circumventing any internal control established by the Company to prevent or detect violations of this policy, or from obstructing any investigation or inquiry to determine compliance with this policy.
An “Agent” is an entity which offers AML RightSource products and services to company customers. A “Commercial Party” is any company, organization, or commercial entity whose employees do not qualify as “Government Officials,” including any employee, agent, trustee, or fiduciary of such party.
The term “Government Official” includes the following:
- Officers and employees of any government department, agency, commission, bureau, or authority, at any level of government (national, state or provincial, regional, or local), whether they are elected, career employees, or political appointees;
- Legislators and judges;
- Any persons acting in an official capacity on behalf of a public authority;
- Officers and employees of entities that are owned or controlled by a public authority;
- Candidates for political office;
- Officers and employees of a political party, as well as the political party as an institution/entity;

chapters.title: Harassment
chapters.text:
Harassment is behavior that makes someone feel uncomfortable, intimidated or offended and is unlawful. It occurs when an employee is subjected to unwelcome verbal or physical conduct, including social media, based on any protected grounds.
Sexual harassment is any unwelcome verbal, written, pictorial, online and/or physical conduct that is based on sex and/or gender or that is sexual in nature. The behavior will be considered harassment if a reasonable person ought to have known that the behavior was unwelcome.
## Workplace Violence
Workplace violence is any act of violence or threatening behavior, which may include mobbing, that occurs between workers and other AML RightSource employees, including managers or with other individuals who are affiliated with our company. AML RightSource is committed to preventing workplace violence and to maintaining a safe work environment.
To reinforce our commitment to a safe and respectful workplace, AML RightSource provides comprehensive training through mandatory sessions for all employees and management, including annual refresher courses and bystander intervention techniques. A confidential reporting mechanism is in place, offering multiple channels for employees to report concerns anonymously and ensuring complaints are handled with discretion and without retaliation (e.g., the Ethics Portal). We have implemented a transparent investigation process, ensuring fairness and timeliness by involving trained professionals and maintaining privacy while communicating outcomes. Our leadership actively fosters a culture of respect and inclusion, promoting diversity initiatives and recognizing positive workplace behaviors. In addition, we conduct regular workplace monitoring and audits, including employee surveys and HR policy reviews, to continuously enhance our respectful and inclusive work environment.
## Women's Professional Development and Empowerment
At AML RightSource, we are deeply committed to fostering the growth and advancement of women across all levels of our organization. Through targeted mentorship and leadership development programs including the weeach office’s Local Culture Committee, we aim to equip our female employees with the confidence, tools, and support necessary to succeed and lead.
We recognize that women often face unique career development barriers, which is why we offer tailored professional growth opportunities. This includes, but is not limited to, workshops, networking events, and skill-building programs that focus on enhancing leadership, communication, and technical expertise. Additionally, we invest in continuous learning by providing access to online learning courses and development programs that enable women to stay competitive in dynamic and evolving industries.
To further support women’s success in the workplace, we promote flexible work arrangements and a culture that values work-life balance. Our family support programs, leave policies, and inclusive workplace culture help ensure that female employees can thrive both personally and professionally. AML RightSource will conduct regular evaluations of its women’s development initiatives to ensure they remain responsive to the evolving needs of our workforce, driving meaningful change and fostering an environment where women are empowered to lead with impact.
## COMPANY COMMUNICATIONS AND SOCIAL MEDIA
AML RightSource recognizes that email communication, messaging communication, and social media sites are important and influential communication tools in supporting Company recruiting, marketing and branding strategies. The Company’s corporate social media (i.e. Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, blogging sites, etc.) is managed by the Company’s Marketing Department.

chapters.title: Work From Home
chapters.text:
Generally, AML RightSource work, and in particular Client Delivery, is performed in the office in a controlled environment to meet client contractual obligations. The Company may provide employees with an alternative to the office-based work setting through a Work from Home Arrangement in specific use cases. This is an exception to general practice and procedure, and the provision of this policy should not be seen as a guaranteed opportunity for work from home. Work arrangements are defined as:
Work From Home: A working arrangement whereby an employee receives approval by the Company to work at their designated home residence, in the country in which they are employed for a specified period of time. Employees working from home are not eligible to relocate outside of their current location (home state, province, region or country) without the approval of management and local Human Resources team. Employees who have been found to have relocated without prior approval will be subject to disciplinary action up to and including termination.
Central Work Site: Traditional workplace that serves as the primary business address for the work from home employee. The Central Work Site is considered the work from home employee’s regular assigned work location when not approved to Work from Home.
AML RightSource may opt to offer or require a work from home arrangement to designated employees under the terms outlined below. Such an arrangement is not an entitlement or fundamental term and condition of employment, and can be revoked at any time. Employees working from home may be required to return to working from their home office location in either a hybrid or full time arrangement at the sole discretion of Company management.:
- All Company Policies and Procedures apply to employees working from home in regard to performance and behavior, including but not limited to the following areas: intellectual property; confidentiality; dissemination of confidential or proprietary Company information; standards of conduct; misuse of Company resources; non-harassment and non-discrimination; and systems, information and data security. Violators will be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including, termination of employment.
- Employees working from home must be able to carry out the same duties, assignments, and other work obligations at their home office as they do when working at the Central Work Site, including attend all mandatory meetings, required continuing education programs, performance evaluation meetings, and to otherwise follow the directions of management.
- Eligibility and qualifications for an employee to be approved to Work From Home is based, in part, on client requirements.
- Performance, quality and productivity expectations will be established and monitored by the employee’s engagement manager.
- Dependent care and/or personal obligations must not interfere with the employee’s job duties or performance expectations. Work From Home is not a replacement for appropriate child/family care.
- The employee, and any preapproved work-related visitors, must be the only individual present in the designated work area during working times.
The employee working from home is prohibited to work from a CCTV deployed area or any place where the recording of the employee’s screen is possible.
If an employee is determined eligible to work from home based on the criteria listed in this policy, or otherwise established by the Company, the employee will be required to complete all of the following:
- Work From Home Worker - Acknowledgement Form
AML RightSource may supply computer hardware and software deemed necessary for work from home, based on approval of Human Resources and Department Heads, under the following terms:
- Equipment, hardware, and software furnished by the Company shall remain the property of the Company and subject to the same business use restrictions as apply when work is performed from the Central Work Site.
- Employees working from home are required to return all company property to a designated Central Work Site, within the timeframe established and communicated by their regional Human Resources Department, after the Work from Home arrangement is discontinued or employment with the Company is terminated.
- Employees working from home are responsible for paying the cost of repair or replacement of Company property that is lost, damaged through negligence or deliberately destroyed when in the employee’s care, custody or control. Any damage to Company property must be reported to the employee’s engagement manager or designee immediately.
- If theft of Company property occurs, the theft must be immediately reported to the local police department as well as to the employee’s engagement manager.

chapters.title: Emergency Preparedness:
chapters.text:
- Keep emergency phone numbers easily accessible.
- Establish emergency procedures for fire safety, including the quickest escape route from your home office.
- Recommend to have a first aid kit available in your home workspace.
If an employee working from home incurs a work-related injury while performing work and during the course of their scheduled workday, workers’ compensation laws and rules may apply, in accordance with applicable law.
- The employee must immediately report any accident or injury to their engagement manager or designee.
- The employee must follow all Company workers’ compensation and injury reporting policies.
- In accordance with the terms and conditions of this policy, the Company reserves the right to investigate all work-related accidents and injuries.
- The Company shall not be responsible or liable for any injury sustained by any visitors or guests in the employee’s residence.
## USE OF MOBILE PHONE AND HANDHELD DEVICES FOR WORK-RELATED PURPOSES
A mobile device is any company owned asset that is portable and intended to be used outside an office setting (i.e. tablet, smart phone). AML RightSource recognizes the risks of using mobile devices for work. As such, Company issued mobile devices require approval from a manager, must be managed by AML RightSource IT, and compliant with the AML RightSource Information Security Policy.
## MOBILE PHONE AND HANDHELD DEVICE USE IN THE WORKPLACE
AML RightSource is committed to reducing the risk of security breaches in the workplace and increasing employee awareness about protecting sensitive and/or confidential information. This policy establishes the appropriate use of mobile phones and handheld devices in the workplace to maintain a professional, productive, and secure environment.
Mobile Phones or Handheld Devices: portable technology with the ability to receive and/or transmit voice, text, images, video, documents, multimedia, or other data messages without a cable connection (including, but not limited to, smart phones, standalone cameras, mobile phone cameras, smart watch cameras, or other personal mobile computing assets with or without cameras). Devices that attach to smart phones, such as smart watches, may constitute Mobile Phones or Handheld Devices under this policy based on device capability (e.g., devices that have cameras and/or data messaging capabilities). Mobile Phones or Handheld Devices does not include AML RightSource or client-issued laptops or smart phones, to the extent such devices are being used for a legitimate business-related purpose.
Non-Public Information: information of any kind, nature, or description concerning any matters affecting or relating to an employee's services for the Company and/or its clients, including the services provided, data, plans or processes. Examples include, but are not limited to, external client data, financial transaction monitoring data, client systems and proprietary information, and Company systems and proprietary information. For further information, please refer to the Data Protection Retention Policy on the IT and Security Page on #OneNet.
## Prohibited Use of Mobile Phones and Handheld Devices
- Many mobile phones are equipped with cameras. AML RightSource prohibits employees from using standalone cameras, camera phones, mobile phone cameras, smartwatches cameras, or other recording devices unless specifically authorized by management.
- Under no circumstances shall any employee be permitted to use any camera function of any device while at a workstation or within sight of workstations. Violation of this section may result in corrective action, including termination of employment.
## Location of Mobile Phones and Handheld Devices During the Workday
The following applies to employees whose workstations have access to Confidential Information:
- Employees are required to leave their mobile phones and handheld devices either in a closed drawer or kept out of sight in a bag or on person (i.e., pocket) at their workstation and on silent mode.
- Employee mobile phones and handheld devices must not be visible to others and should not be accessed or used while employees view confidential information. This also extends to the period when mobile phones require charging. The employee should not use the IT asset (i.e., desktop or laptop) sockets for the charging purpose of any personal mobile or handheld device.
- The only exception to the above is if an employee is required to use mobile phones and/or handheld devices for multi-factor authentication. In this case, the employee may use their mobile phones and/or handheld devices for authentication purposes in accordance with the applicable authentication policy, and then place their mobile phones and/or handheld devices back in drawer/bag/pocket as soon as authentication is complete.

chapters.title: Diversity Equity And Inclusion
chapters.text:
Diversity, equity, and inclusion are core to who we are, what we do and how we practice our values. We collectively commit to drive our culture where differences are nurtured, evolve equitably, and explore experiences to give a sense of belonging where people are inspired to team up and lead inclusively in their everyday functions.
At AML RightSource, we fundamentally function towards diverse thinking, equal opportunity, and an inclusive approach to fulfill our organization's mission to be the global, end-to-end, tech-enabled services company, serving as a true partner and trusted advisor to our clients.
At AML RightSource, our Global Culture Playbook located on the People and Culture page, is a valuable tool that helps employees navigate our highly diverse population. It is a practical guide of who we are, what we do, and how we do things. This guide is backed by a global approach in understanding and training our employees to foster a strong OneTeam culture.
Equity is about recognizing that everyone has different experiences. Based on everyone's backgrounds and identities, everyone faces diverse levels of structural and systemic advantages and disadvantages that impact access to resources, perception and evaluation, and sense of belonging in and out of the workplace.
At AML Rightsource, our Local Culture Committees promote a sense of belonging within the workplace by identifying and celebrating specific cultural practices followed by the employees in all of our geographic locations.
Inclusion is about creating a welcoming culture in which differences are celebrated and everyone is valued, respected, and able to reach their full potential. There is a sense of belonging and safer feeling to surface many aspects of who they are and encourage them to bring forward their perspectives and ideas.
At AML RightSource, one of our greatest tools to serve inclusion in the workplace is Peakon. Peakon is one of the leading employee engagement platforms which helps us identify and value employee voices and feedback, allowing us to make positive changes to our company culture.

chapters.title: Attendance
chapters.text:
Employees are expected to report to work each day and should consult the attendance policy or leave policy for the country in which they are employed, as there are local variances to our attendance and leave policies based on country-specific requirements.
- If it is not possible to report to work as scheduled for any reason, including but not limited to, sickness, unexpected personal circumstances, weather, etc., employees must contact their manager prior to the start of their regularly scheduled start time and enter their time off in Workday as soon as possible (either same day or as soon as returning to work). Employees must ensure that they know their manager’s email address in order to notify their manager of any last-minute unplanned time off. Employees may send an email from their personal email account when sick or unable to work if they do not have access to their work email.
- Notifying the Company of any absence is the responsibility of every employee who is unable to report to work some or all of the employee’s regularly scheduled time on any given day. Failure to report absences and/or excessive tardiness may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.
- The Company places the safety of the employee first and understands that on occasion inclement weather may make it difficult for employees to get to work. Employees are expected to make arrangements during periods of inclement weather which will enable them to arrive as soon as possible. Should an employee feel unsafe driving or commuting they are to inform their manager immediately.
- The Company will not penalize an employee for lateness or absence during inclement weather if a genuine effort has been made to get to work. Normally employees will be provided with the opportunity to select from the choices listed in the procedures below to cover the missed time.
- Work from home (for those employees who are set up and approved to work from home)
- Using Paid Time Off (annual leave, vacation)
- Taking an Unpaid Day (UPT).
- If applicable to your role, you may be allowed to flex hours with approval from your manager. When employees are absent from work due to a personal illness, they may be required to provide medical documentation as outlined in the attendance policy of the country in which they are employed. Medical documentation may also be required upon the employee’s return to work.
- The Company reserves the right to request medical documentation to support an absence whenever it deems necessary, in accordance with local employment laws.
- Employees who are required to provide medical documentation, as per the terms of the attendance policy, must visit a doctor and secure said note for the day that the employee was absent from work. If a medical note is requested after an employee returns to work, the employee must secure a medical note as soon as possible. Failure to provide medical documentation when required or requested may result in denial of sick time benefits and/or further disciplinary action.
- It is expected that an employee will schedule personal/medical appointments during non-working hours. If this is not possible, the employee is expected to schedule these appointments at the very beginning or at the end of the business day to limit their time away from work. If the appointment is scheduled during working hours, the employee shall give reasonable notice to their manager to obtain approval for this time away from work.
- An unapproved absence of three consecutive workdays without any notification is considered job abandonment (unless failure to give notice was reasonably beyond the control of the employee). Job abandonment will be considered a voluntary resignation of employment, and the employee will be removed from the payroll and system access. Please refer to your country-specific attendance policy for further details.
Employees are expected to report to work and scheduled meetings on time.
## Management Oversight
Managers are expected to fairly and consistently manage employees’ attendance and punctuality. Excessive absences and tardiness are expected to be addressed accordingly and may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination. Managers should reach out to their local Human Resources representative if any cases of excessive absences or consistent punctuality issues arise.

chapters.title: Compensation
chapters.text:
The company is committed to complying with applicable laws regarding compensation and time reporting. Compensation for all employees is in accordance with local employment laws. Please refer to the payroll page on #OneNet for further information.
Workday is defined as the 24-hour period that commences at 12:00 am and concludes at 11:59 pm.
## Work week is defined as the 168-hour period, encompassing seven (7) consecutive 24-hour periods, which commences on Sunday at 12:00 am and concludes at 11:59 pm the following Saturday.
## Pay Schedule
The Company pay schedules vary based on the jurisdiction in which you are employed. Employees should refer to their employment contract/offer letter for details of their pay schedule.
## Tax Withholding
The Company is required to withhold tax and report taxable income according to the requirements of local laws.
- All employees are required to complete appropriate tax withholding forms upon employment by the Company.
- Employees are required to complete and submit revised tax withholding forms whenever there are changes to an employee’s tax status, geographical location of employment, or they need to make changes based on their personal circumstances. It is the employee's responsibility to complete and submit these forms to payroll.
- Employees will be provided with the appropriate tax withholding forms at time of hire and can reach out to payroll if they require additional forms for tax revisions.
## Correction of Errors
Any pay discrepancies or other pay irregularities discovered by the employee must be reported to Payroll immediately. If it is determined that an improper deduction has been made, the employee will be reimbursed, and the company will take the necessary steps to prevent the recurrence of errors in the future. When accidental overpayments occur, the employee will be contacted by HR or payroll to coordinate collection of overpayments in accordance with local payroll and employment laws.
## Garnishment
When an employee’s wages are garnished by a court order, the Company is legally required to withhold the amount indicated in the garnishment order from the employee’s paycheck. This requirement only applies to those jurisdictions where required by applicable law. Any questions in relation to garnishments should be directed to the appropriate garnishment agency.
## Measures to Promote Fair Compensation
To ensure fair and lawful compensation, AMLRS follows several key practices. Salaries are regularly benchmarked against industry standards and reviewed annually based on performance and market trends. The company aims to align compensation with role, responsibilities, and experience while also taking into account its current financial position. Compliance with wage laws and overtime rules is ensured through regular audits. The company promotes open communication, encouraging employees to raise compensation concerns confidentially. Pay equity is closely monitored to prevent imbalances, and any payroll issues are addressed promptly in line with legal and internal policies.

chapters.title: Performance Evaluationss
chapters.text:
The Company believes in communicating performance-related feedback on an ongoing basis. The performance evaluation process provides a formal means for discussing, planning and reviewing the performance of each employee. Eligible employees will participate in the semi-annual or annual review process based on their position in partnership with their manager.
Annual merit increases will be evaluated following completion of the year-end performance evaluation process as part of the compensation review process. Any increases, promotions or bonuses will take effect on a date determined by the company, but generally within 3 months of the completion of the performance review period.
The company has the discretion to make changes to the performance evaluation process including timelines, eligibility, and effective date of promotions, bonuses, and compensation increases. Please review OneNet Performance Management for further details.
An employee within a termination notice period may be eligible for a performance evaluation, but may also be excluded from receiving a compensation adjustment due to pending termination of employment.
## DISCIPLINARY ACTION AND PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT PLANS
The Company addresses substandard attendance, behavior, conduct and performance through the following methods:

chapters.title: Disciplinary Action
chapters.text:
The disciplinary action process is designed to alert employees regarding attendance, behavior and misconduct issues that do not align with the Company standards and policies. In determining the appropriate disciplinary action, Management in consultation with Human Resources, will consider the nature and seriousness of the behavior or conduct, the circumstances of the situation, any prior disciplinary action, and other appropriate factors. The Company will then take appropriate action and document this action in the employee’s file based on the country specific policy. When applicable, an investigation will be conducted by Human Resources.
Please refer to your relevant country specific policies on #OneNet for more details.
## Performance Improvement Plan (PIP)
Employees are expected to comply with the Company standards of performance and any noncompliance with these standards will be addressed. If an employee is performing below standards/expectations, their manager may use a PIP to address low performance. The purpose of a PIP is to notify the employee of their current performance, expected performance, and develop an action plan to improve performance over a specific monitoring period. Based on the exact need, the monitoring period may vary. Ultimately, the goal of the PIP is to help the employee meet performance expectations, however, if the employee fails to meet performance expectations it may result in termination of employment.
Please refer to your relevant country specific policies on #OneNet.
## BENEFITS
The Company provides a benefits package to eligible employees. Contact your local HR department or refer to #OneNet for further details of the benefits offered, if applicable, for your region. The Company reserves the right to terminate, change or modify any benefit, including eligibility, at any time.
## PAID TIME OFF, LEAVES OF ABSENCE AND PUBLIC HOLIDAYS
AML RightSource recognizes the importance of work-life balance. As a result, eligible employees are provided with annual paid leave (PTO, Vacation, Annual Leave) and employees are encouraged to take time throughout the year to rest and recharge. Employees should refer to their offer letter/employment contract for details on their paid annual leave. Employees are responsible for proactively requesting their paid leave throughout the year and entering their time off in advance on Workday for approval by their managers in accordance with their local annual paid leave policies.
The Company also provides employees with a variety of other paid and unpaid leaves which vary based on region of employment.
Employees can refer to the policies on paid annual leave and leaves of absence for their respective region of employment on #OneNet. Employees may also direct questions to their local Human Resources team.
The Company observes public holidays within each country in which we operate. Please refer to the holiday calendar on #OneNet to see the paid public holidays observed in the country in which you are employed.
When a public holiday falls on a weekend, or while the employee is on a paid or unpaid leave, the Company will follow applicable employment laws regarding substitute holiday time or holiday pay.
## EMPLOYEE OFFBOARDING
Offboarding is the process that leads to the formal separation between an employee and the Company through resignation, termination, or retirement. It is the policy of AML RightSource to ensure that employee off boarding is handled in a professional manner with minimal disruption to the workplace.
- Employees are requested to provide the appropriate notice period, as outlined in their respective employment agreement, to the Company of their intention to separate employment.
- Employees are required to submit their resignations electronically via Workday and where it is required by law, employees will be required to provide a hard copy of the resignation letter.
- Upon receipt of an employee’s resignation, Human Resources will initiate the off-boarding process. This off-boarding process may vary by country as a result of jurisdictional requirements. This will include notifying IT to remove employee access to client and AML RightSource systems by end of business day on their last day of employment and coordinating prompt return of all client and company equipment. Upon a notice of resignation, the employee will be invited to participate in the company exit interview survey. The Company uses this data to determine how to improve the employment experience with AML RightSource and appreciate any feedback employees can provide.
- An employee’s final pay will be processed in accordance with local employment laws and regulations.
